sql: WITH last AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.market_ticker) s.* FROM incentive_market_snapshots s WHERE s.at > now() - interval '2 hours' ORDER BY s.market_ticker, s.at DESC), prog AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) * FROM incentive_programs WHERE superseded_at IS NULL AND disappeared_at IS NULL AND incentive_type='liquidity' AND end_date > now() + interval '24 hours' ORDER BY market_ticker, last_seen_at DESC), j AS ( SELECT l.*, p.close_time, extract(epoch from p.close_time - now())/86400 close_d FROM last l JOIN prog p USING (market_ticker)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM last) snaps, (SELECT count(*) FROM prog) progs, count(*) joined, count(*) FILTER (WHERE est_yes_meets_target AND est_no_meets_target) qual, count(*) FILTER (WHERE close_d BETWEEN 7 AND 60) in_window, count(*) FILTER (WHERE close_d BETWEEN 7 AND 60 AND est_yes_meets_target AND est_no_meets_target) win_qual, count(*) FILTER (WHERE close_d BETWEEN 7 AND 60 AND est_yes_meets_target AND est_no_meets_target AND best_yes_bid<=10 AND best_no_bid<=10) win_qual_cheap, count(*) FILTER (WHERE close_d BETWEEN 7 AND 60 AND est_yes_meets_target AND est_no_meets_target AND least(best_yes_bid,best_no_bid)<=10) win_qual_one_cheap FROM j
